newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end down, S&Ps fall fast.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end down, S&Ps fall fast.

text.p: Dec 16 - U.S. stock index futures closed lower. March S&Ps finished the day sharply lower after a late, fast fall. Traders said declines in Nasdaq, the U.S. dollar, weighed on the market. Commission house selling picked up speed, sending March through the 5-1/2-week low of 725.95. Support is at 722.45, a one-third retracement level of the five-mos upmove.
